items.title: Today's PHP security release, and how we're strengthening security
items.blurb: Describing the story behind how critical security vulnerabilities were found and fixed.

items.title: Upcoming Critical PHP Security Release
items.blurb: PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that powers everything from your blog to the most popular websites in the world.

items.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources fx: A Zig Coding Agent Designed to Be Embedded
items.blurb: Vercel Labs has released fx, an experimental open-source coding agent written in Zig. It runs as a CLI, a script component, or an embedded library, including a WebAssembly build.

items.title: AWS Transform adds storage migration assessments for Amazon S3, EBS, EFS, and FSx
items.blurb: Migration assessments in AWS Transform now evaluate on-premises storage for migration to AWS.

items.title: AWS Direct Connect announces 100G expansion in Manchester, England
items.blurb: Today, AWS announced the expansion of 10 Gbps and 100 Gbps dedicated connections with MACsec encryption capabilities at the existing AWS Direct Connect location in the Equinix MA3 data center near Manchester, England.

items.title: Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS now support On-Demand Capacity Reservations
items.blurb: Starting today, you can reserve compute capacity for your Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS DB instances in one or more Availability Zones for as long as you need it.

items.title: Amazon Cognito extends multi-Region replication to AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
items.blurb: Amazon Cognito multi-Region replication (MRR) now supports AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, extending the resilience benefits of MRR to more workloads.

items.title: AWS Neuron 2.33 adds native PyTorch support, Neuron Observer, and other new features
items.blurb: AWS Neuron 2.33 is now available, introducing TorchNeuron, the native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium, in public beta.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer launches two new layouts for agent workspace
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now offers two different layouts that optimize screen space on the agent workspace.
